name: How do I choose the right contractor for disability remodeling?

mainEntity.name: How do I choose the right contractor for disability remodeling?

acceptedAnswer.text: Look for a contractor who has hands-on experience with structural framing, tile work, and sub-trade coordination rather than someone who only attaches surface accessories. True accessibility often demands moving walls, leveling subfloors, and rebuilding shower pans from the ground up. Choose a licensed, BBB-accredited business with an A+ rating that offers a single point of contact on site. Working directly with the lead contractor ensures that safety-critical specifications—such as solid wood framing backing and slope drainage—are built correctly without communication gaps.
acceptedAnswer.description: Choose an experienced, hands-on general contractor who handles framing, tile, and trade coordination directly to ensure structural safety.
